NSUI Protests Alleged Police Assault on Women Members During Delhi Protest

Members of the National Students' Union of India (NSUI) staged a dharna (protest) at a police station over allegations of assault on their women members during a protest in Delhi. NSUI national president Vinod Jakhar led hundreds of activists who initially gathered at Gate 7 of the Rajiv Chowk Metro station. Police detained Jakhar and several other protesters, according to the student organization. Leaders from the Indian Youth Congress (IYC) and NSUI visited injured activists following the Delhi protest.
